claims.text: The pool villas sit within tropical rainforest on a hillside beside the South China Sea on Sentosa island.

findings.quote: At Singapore's first all-villa resort, cocooned within breeze-cooled tropical rainforest on the island of Sentosa, 62 sophisticated, sensorial pool villas meander down a hillside beside the South China Sea.
findings.note: rainforest, hillside, South China Sea, Sentosa

claims.text: Villa interiors are inspired by contemporary Singaporean design with touches of tradition.

findings.quote: Inspired by contemporary Singaporean design with touches of tradition felt throughout the interiors

claims.text: Interconnecting villas are available for families or groups of friends.

findings.quote: For guests travelling with family or a close circle of friends, interconnecting villas offer the perfect balance of togetherness and privacy

claims.text: Villa guests have a butler available all day.

findings.quote: the butler – who is available to you all day

claims.text: Private in-villa dining is offered with a bespoke menu and butler service.

findings.quote: Relax and enjoy personalised private dining in the comfort and seclusion of your
villa, with a bespoke menu and attentive butler service.

claims.text: Empire Grill is the resort's relaxed modern Italian signature restaurant, serving classic Tuscan fare.

findings.quote: take your seat at Empire Grill for lunch. Our relaxed modern Italian signature restaurant serves classic Tuscan fare

claims.text: Royal China serves Cantonese cuisine, with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the garden.

findings.quote: Dinner is at Royal China, where you will enjoy refined Cantonese cuisine in an inspiring setting with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the garden.

claims.text: Raffles Sentosa Spa is housed in a heritage building.

findings.quote: Housed in a heritage building, Raffles Spa is where serenity meets vitality
Here, within a characterful heritage building, serenity meets vitality

claims.text: The spa offers yoga, mindfulness, massage, fitness, hydrotherapy and science-based skincare.

findings.quote: encompassing yoga, mindfulness, massage, fitness, hydrotherapy and science-based skincare

claims.text: The spa has indoor hot and cold plunge pools.

findings.quote: Indoor Hot and Cold Plunge Pools

claims.text: Naturalist-led birdwatching walks on Sentosa are run by The Untamed Paths along the Mount Imbiah Nature Trail.

findings.quote: you are invited to discover Sentosa Island's vibrant birdlife, curated by naturalists from The Untamed Paths
Walk the Mount Imbiah Nature Trail

claims.text: A Wellbeing Butler leads scent-making sessions where guests design their own fragrance to take home.

findings.quote: In the afternoon, join a scent-making session led by our Wellbeing Butler. Select from a curated collection of luxurious oils to design a unique scent tailored to your preference.
a unique bespoke fragrance that you can take home

claims.text: Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property to open on Sentosa, and the second Raffles address in Singapore.

findings.quote: Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property to open on Singapore's 'island in the city', and the second Raffles address in the country where Raffles was born.
findings.note: first all-villa on Sentosa, second Raffles in Singapore

findings.quote: At Singapore's first all-villa resort, cocooned within breeze-cooled tropical rainforest on the island of Sentosa

claims.text: Each villa has separate pavilions for day and night, plus a private outdoor pool and terrace.

findings.quote: Discover separate pavilions for day and night, while a private outdoor pool and terrace expand the living experience

claims.text: The hotel offers a guided tour of Singapore in the resort's Rolls-Royce, with a private guide and lunch at a heritage restaurant.

findings.quote: in the resort’s Rolls-Royce. On your personalised four-hour itinerary led by a private guide, you will explore the city's cultural landmarks and hidden neighbourhoods, with lunch at a heritage restaurant.
findings.note: Rolls-Royce, private guide, heritage restaurant lunch

claims.text: The resort has its own version of the Singapore Sling, the Raffles Sentosa Sling, with mixologist-led tasting sessions.

findings.quote: Raffles Sentosa Sling tasting session led by a mixologist, describing how we developed our version of the famous Singapore Sling.
findings.note: Raffles Sentosa Sling tasting led by mixologist

claims.text: Guests can take a private yacht tour of Sisters' Islands.

findings.quote: Today we’ll take you on a private yacht tour of Sisters’ Islands

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the Sentosa Island location is less convenient for spontaneous trips into Singapore's city centre.
WhataHotel notes the all-villa format puts the resort at the higher end of Singapore's luxury pricing.
